text:
kara: quick UX check — when a policy has many rules the vertical list feels like a wall. thinking about a compact list mode that preserves name + status but hides long descriptions. thoughts?

diego: compact mode is useful. keep the drag target visible and increase hit area for keyboard users.

rachel: agree. propose an icon row for key attrs (region, model, action) in compact view. hover/focus expands full metadata.

kara: good. also the reorder handle is tiny on mobile. maybe show a reorder toggle that swaps the list into a move-mode with explicit up/down controls.

sam: accessibility note — when moving items with keyboard we should emit aria-live: "Moved 'Allow EU Traffic' to position 3" and keep focus on the moved item.

ops-bot: sim-run: priority-clash detected for policy 307 — conflicting actions at same priority. Inline warnings recommended.

rachel: inline warning pill under rule title: "priority clash" + tooltip explaining fallback and suggested fix. small and low-contrast.

diego: also in preview sim a tiny sparkline for each rule showing relative hits would help surface which rules actually fire. hover shows counts.

kara: love the sparkline idea. ensure color isn't the only signal (add dots or labels) and provide aria summary for top rules. I'll update the spec and request mocks.

sam: I'll draft the aria strings and focus behavior checklist.

kara: thanks all — aiming to get mocks by Tuesday.
